corrections.why: Current listings name Nez Perce National Forest. Rex's Fire Lookout Page says the administration moved from Bitterroot to Nez Perce in 1957, so Bitterroot was the earlier agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's Fire Lookout Page gives 32N-12E-33, while the Forest Service list gives T32N, R12E Sect. 23. The story gives no section number.

Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list describe a patrol tower. Rex's Fire Lookout Page describes an L-4 cab on a ten-foot tower from an undated inventory. Both descriptions can fit the same site, so the record keeps both.

sources.title: Nez Perce National Forest Lookouts (list compiled April 2010 from Ray Kresek's Fire Lookouts of the Northwest)

notes_for_editor: Agency is the main correction: the brief has Bitterroot NF, but current sources say Nez Perce NF, with the 1957 transfer. Section number disagrees between Rex's page (33) and the FS list (23); the story avoids it. Staffing: no source found. The 1934 L-4 entry comes from an undated inventory, so it is shown as a listing, not a dated build. No photos added. The FS PDF is a text extraction: the cite 4 quotes are single-line fragments of the Tony Point row, which also carries the 1933 and abandoned-1950 columns.
